name: robotarmy-forked
title: Robot Army (forked)
author: Kyranzor (fork maintained by the community)
description: Manufacture and deploy automated robot soldiers to attack your foes and defend your factory! This is a maintained fork of Robot Army by Kyranzor (https://mods.factorio.com/mod/robotarmy - source: https://github.com/kyranf/robotarmyfactorio), credited as the original author. Main difference from the original: switching from the original mod (or adding this one to an existing save) no longer strands your army - on first load all droid assemblers, guard stations and other mod buildings are re-registered, deployed droids are automatically re-adopted into squads and consolidated back up to strength, and recipes unlocked by your research are re-enabled, so existing saves keep working as a drop-in replacement.
